items.title: Vincent Pelote interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 25, 2017
items.q: And Billie. The face on her when he’s playing that solo. I mean she’s just like —

ctx.x: I love that moment that they captured on “The Sound of Jazz” with Lester and Billie.
And Billie. The face on her when he’s playing that solo. I mean she’s just like —
Just about a month ago I finally sat down and tried to write out his solo.
